violation_type.title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities (26 TAC §746.2202(4))
violation_type.short_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities
violation_type.typical_finding: Activities for a child with a special need were not develop and provided to a caregiver.

finding_variants.text: Activities for a child with a special need were not develop and provided to a caregiver.

An activity plan was not available for 1/3 of the classes. Of the two activity plans posted, neither were within this week's date.  One was dated May 26, the other was dated June 2nd. Also, they should state the group name they were written for.

Two children with special needs were placed in high chairs for an extended period and  not given activities that allowed them to participate in the planned daily activity in the least restrictive environment possible.

This standard was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation and found deficient.     Based on information provided a child with special care needs was said to be put to the side in the classroom or outside on the playground and not included as part of day to day activities.
This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance when it was determined that a child with special care needs was excluded from the class for a day.
For a duration of about 30 minutes, a child with special needs was observed sitting in the same spot, playing with the same toys.
